levels.surface: أحمد بن أبي عبد الله البرقي

notes: «حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي» : أبي is named only by relation to the compiler, so a relation link; «جَمِيعاً» marks co-transmitters whose routes meet at the next name

«أبي عبد الله» sits after «عن» in the chain: a narrator (owner ruling 2); the closing «قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ يَرْفَعُهُ» names a further transmitter after the saying and no rule settles it, so it is not read as a route
